recent.text: The Dodgers added RHP Christian Zazueta and LHPs Jackson Ferris, Adam Serwinowski and Luke Fox to the 40-man roster. In order to make room, the Dodgers designated RHP Jake Cousins and IF Christian Cairo for assignment.
recent.author: Los Angeles Dodgers
